heading_path: Re-running failed jobs in a workflow

content.text:
No — per **content/actions/how-tos/manage-workflow-runs/re-run-workflows-and-jobs.md** ("Re-running failed jobs in a workflow"), "Re-run failed jobs" only re-runs entire **jobs** that failed — there's no per-step control to force a successful step to re-run within that operation.

Workaround: since re-running is job-level, split your setup step into its own job (or make the setup job itself fail/be re-triggered), so re-running the failed job includes the setup step again. Alternatively use "Re-run all jobs" (same doc, "Re-running all the jobs in a workflow" section) to force everything, including the environment setup, to run again.
